label: Town of Guilford
header:
# Town of Guilford municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 10; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Guilford Selectboard page (guilfordvt.gov): lists Sheila Morse (Chair), Tara Cheney (Vice-Chair), Michael Szostak, Kimberly Frost, and Chip Carter.
Town of Guilford FY2025 Town Report (guilfordvt.gov): the March 4, 2025 town meeting minutes in the report record Morse elected to a three-year term and Cheney to a two-year term.

Town of Guilford, 'March 3rd Official Election Results' (guilfordvt.gov): the town's official March 3, 2026 results elect Kimberly M. Frost to a three-year term and Michael Szostak to a two-year term.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists no Guilford roster; the town's own pages carry the board.

Town of Guilford FY2025 Town Report (guilfordvt.gov): the moderator is elected at the floor town meeting (February 28, 2026 for this cycle); the winner is published in no official source read. Structure only.
Town of Guilford, 'March 3rd Official Election Results' (guilfordvt.gov): the town's official March 3, 2026 results re-elect Uriel Najera Town Clerk to a three-year term.
Town of Guilford FY2025 Town Report (guilfordvt.gov): Najera won the remaining one year of the clerk's term at the March 4, 2025 meeting with 500 votes.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Uriel Najera as Guilford town clerk.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Ellen Majonen as Guilford town treasurer.

Town of Guilford FY2025 Town Report (guilfordvt.gov): calls Ellen 'Elly' Majonen 'our Treasurer' in the treasurer's report; the office appears in neither the 2025 meeting's elective business nor the 2026 ballot warning's elective list. Recorded as an appointment to a town office.
Town of Guilford Collector of Delinquent Taxes page (guilfordvt.gov): the office 'is appointed each year by the Town Selectboard' and Ellen (Elly) Majonen holds it.

Town of Guilford FY2025 Town Report (guilfordvt.gov): the March 4, 2025 minutes elect Richard 'Dick' Smith lister to a three-year term, and the listers' own report is signed by Smith, Shaun Murphy, and Steve Soszynski.
Town of Guilford, 'March 3rd Official Election Results' (guilfordvt.gov): the official March 3, 2026 results elect Shaun Murphy lister to a three-year term.

Town of Guilford FY2025 Town Report (guilfordvt.gov): the March 4, 2025 minutes elect Lyndsey Mitchell auditor to a three-year term (the third seat, Reita Lashway's one-year remainder, expired in 2026 with no successor in the 2026 warning, so it is unfilled).
Town of Guilford, 'March 3rd Official Election Results' (guilfordvt.gov): the official March 3, 2026 results elect Skye Morse auditor to a three-year term.
Town of Guilford Cemetery Commission page (guilfordvt.gov): the commissioners serve five-year staggered terms with one seat elected at each annual floor meeting, which fixes five seats.

Town of Guilford FY2025 Town Report (guilfordvt.gov): the March 4, 2025 floor meeting elected Carol Schnabel a cemetery commissioner; the February 28, 2026 floor winner and the remaining seats are published nowhere official, so they are unfilled.

Town of Guilford FY2025 Town Report (guilfordvt.gov): the trustees of public funds serve five-year staggered terms with one seat elected at each annual floor meeting, which fixes five seats; the March 4, 2025 floor meeting elected Todd Mandell. The 2026 floor winner and the remaining seats are unpublished and unfilled.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists ten justices of the peace for Guilford.

jp_election.name: Town of Guilford Justice of the Peace Election 2024-11-05

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): the SOS listing names the ten Guilford winners of the November 5, 2024 justice of the peace election. No library-trustee post is created: the Guilford Free Library's nine-trustee board mixes town-elected and association trustees with no fixed elected count in any official source.
